subject: Invoice origination + delivery: email-first fallback to portal for urgent POs
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <accounts-payable@neoholdings.com>
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:32:00 -0800
Subject: Question: preferred delivery for invoice on PO 47821

Hi Sofia,

We're reconciling an urgent PO (47821) and want to confirm how Redwood will send the invoice for this contract month. Our AP team prefers portal delivery for automated ingestion, but they flagged that portal processing can take 24–48h after upload.

Because this is tied to an end-of-month close for Neoholdings, can you confirm whether Redwood can (1) send a PDF invoice to accounts-payable@neoholdings.com the same day as generation, and (2) also upload to your portal (so internal reconciliation matches)? If we get an email copy it helps us submit the payment run this week.

Thanks — looking to avoid a missed cutoff.

Best,
Alicia Gomez
Accounts Payable Manager
Neoholdings, Inc.

--
Attachment: PO_47821.pdf (application/pdf, 165KB)

From: sofia_ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <accounts-payable@neoholdings.com>
Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 10:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Question: preferred delivery for invoice on PO 47821

Hi Alicia —

Thanks for flagging. Yes, we can accommodate the email-first approach for urgent closes: immediate PDF by email on generation + same-file upload to the billing portal (we'll mark the portal upload as "email-copy-sent" so your system can match). Two quick notes:

- We need a billing contact (single email) for delivery copies and PO validation — is accounts-payable@neoholdings.com the canonical address?
- If there are specific PO->Invoice mapping fields (GL codings, cost-center), please share the small mapping so we include them on the PDF header.

I'll loop in Finance Ops (Mina) to confirm generation timing and Ben on the portal upload SLA.

Sofia Ivanova
Head of Billing Operations
Redwood Inference

Sofia — quick operational notes from Finance Ops:

- Email-first: we can auto-generate the PDF and trigger an SMTP send within the same job that marks the invoice as "issued". That satisfies same-day email delivery.
- Portal upload: the uploader job runs in parallel but a separate queue. Typical portal visibility is within 2–36 hours depending on file size and processing.
- Required metadata for matching: PO number (we already have), Vendor ref, and an optional "external_reference" field. If Neoholdings can include cost-center on the PO, we can stamp it on the PDF.

Potential snag: if the portal detects a duplication on upload (email copy + portal ingest), their system might flag it — we should send the portal filename as "NEOH_47821_emailcopy.pdf" to reduce collision risk. Ben — can the portal uploader add that naming convention and include a metadata JSON next to the upload?

Thanks,
Mina
Finance Ops Manager
Redwood Inference

Hi Alicia —

Quick update from the billing-platform side: we can do the email-first + portal upload flow and I validated the following implementation details:

- File naming: we'll push the portal file as NEOH_47821_emailcopy.pdf and store a sidecar metadata JSON with fields {"po":47821, "external_reference": "NEOH-PO-47821", "email_sent": true}. (Neoholdings, if you prefer a different external_reference we can set it.)
- Portal ingestion SLA: uploads are processed by a worker pool; average visibility for 90% of uploads is <6 hours. We can't guarantee 24hr worst-case, but the <6h median should cover most cutoffs.
- Duplicate detection: we will include a header in the PDF with a unique invoice identifier (RED-INV-20261124-0932) so even if the portal flags duplicates your AP can match by that ID.

Next steps: Sofia to confirm the billing delivery address and any cost-center mapping. Alicia — if accounts-payable@neoholdings.com is good, we'll send today's invoice (attached) by email now and schedule the portal upload.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Senior Product Ops Engineer, Billing Platform
Redwood Inference
